title: Shaktiyan Kaam Karna Band Kyun Ho Jaati Hain? — 4 Galtiyan Jo Sadhak Ko Kabhi Nahi Karni Chahiye base

segments.text: Bhaiya Ka Gyaan — Knowledge Base
Topic: Sadhna/Shaktiyan Kaam Karna Kyun Band Ho Jaati Hain (4 Common Galtiyan)

Source: Bhaiya ka satsang/discussion session (video transcript, ~1hr 12min) Purpose: Chatbot knowledge — users k o guide karne ke liye ki unki sadhna/shakti/drishti kyun ruk gayi aur kya NAHI karna hai.
1. CORE PROBLEM (Yeh session kis baare mein hai)
Jo log bhakti kar rahe hain — R am ka jaap, "Jai Siya Ram" ka jap, niyamit sadhna, shakti jagrit ki hui hai — unme se k uch logon ke saath yeh hota hai:

Kaam achanak rukne lagta hai ya ekdum band ho jaata hai Drishti (spiritual vision) ekdum band ho jaati hai Shaktiyon ka asar kam ho jaata hai Physically, ﬁnancially, mentally dobara dikk at aane lagti hai

Bhaiya ne aise sabhi cases ki case study ki (Baba se poochkar), aur har case mein 4 common galtiyan mili. In 4 ke alawa 5th koi case banta hi nahi (exception ho sakta hai, par woh bahut rare hai — "e xceptions are always there", woh individual case hota hai).
Key philosophy: Har vyakti sikhaata hai kya KARNA hai. Par agar aapko pata pad jaaye ki kya NAHI karna hai, to aap bahut kuch seekh jaoge.

Promise: Jo yeh 4 galtiyan nahi karta, uske upar Gurudev ki aisi mahima rehti hai ki brahmand ki koi bhi shakti uske saamne nahi tikegi — yahan tak ki Narayan tattva bhi nahi. (Gurudev k o sakshi maankar bola gaya hai.)
2. Ashaeiynn KA WORKING MODEL (System kaise kaam karta hai)
Yeh samajhna zaroori hai kyunki saari galtiyan isi model se related hain:
End-to-End Connection

Ashaeiynn mein har insaan ko individually, directly Gurudev (Hanuman Ji Maharaj) se joda jaata hai — k abhi bhi bhaiya ke through nahi. Isliye yahan guru parampara hai hi nahi ("hamare guru Hanuman Ji Maharaj hain to hum aapke guru banenge" — aisa k abhi nahi hota). Ek end par aap ho, doosre end par Guru ki shakti hai. Beech mein koi aur connection NAHI hai. Jab bhi vyakti sankalp ke saath, vachano ke saath aavahan karta hai (deepak lagata hai, prarthana karta hai), to udhar ki shakti turant answer/revert deti hai.
Password & Portal Concept (sabse important metaphor)

End-to-end connection mein har vyakti ko ek alag password diya jaata hai (astrally). Jaise hi woh password lagate ho, ek portal khulta hai — wahan se shaktiyan jaati hain aur aati hain. That's all. Aapki vidhi, aapka sankalp, aapke mantra, aapke ghar ke niyam = aapka password. Agar aapne kisi ko apni vidhi/sankalp/remedy bata di → aapne apna password de diya → us vyakti ko aapke ghar ki saari shaktiyon ka access mil gaya.
Kalyan Lok System

Ghar mein deepak lagakar prarthana: "He Hanuman Ji Maharaj, jitni bhi negativity hai un sabko mal sahit baandhit karke Kalyan Lok bhej diya jaaye — Bhaiya k o sakshi maankar prarthana karta/karti hoon." Shaktiyan turant negativity ko baandhkar Kalyan Lok bhej deti hain — by default yahi hota hai. Guru vachan itna strong hai ki bhaiya ko sakshi maankar Hanuman Ji Maharaj ko samarpit kiya gaya deepak/bhog hamesha Hanuman Ji Maharaj tak hi jaayega — brahmand ki k oi shakti beech mein nahi aa sakti. (Par uska RETURN gift intercept ho sakta hai — dekho Case 2.)
3. GALTI #1 — EMPATH / KARUNAMAYI LOG (Apni vidhi doosron ko baant dena)
Kaun log
Empathetic people ("empaths") — mann mein bahut k aruna hoti hai, har vyakti ko daya ke bhaav se dekhte hain.

Sochte hain: "Bechara Ravi itne dard mein hai, isko Jai Siya Ram ke baare mein pata hi nahi hoga, kyun na main isko naam de doon / vidhi bata doon / remedy bata doon." Ya: "Iske paas paise nahi hain Ashaeiynn join karne ke, to chhoti si remedy bata dete hain."
Kya galat hota hai (mechanism)

1. Aapka Guru se end-to-end connection hai; aapne teesre vyakti ko apni vidhi/mantra/sankalp bata diya = apna password de diya. 2. Ab Guru ki shakti to aapke channel se hi aayegi, par aap woh urja aage baant rahe ho — jo urja AAPKE hisse aani thi, woh us teesre vyakti ke paas jaayegi. 3. Ulta traﬃc bhi aapk e through hi chalega: jab us vyakti ki negativity/malinta Kalyan Lok jaayegi, woh bhi aapke through jaayegi — uski pr oblems aapko jhelni padengi. 4. Result: aapke paas urja bachegi hi nahi. Aap "beech ke bandar" bankar reh jaoge — na idhar ke na udhar ke. 5. Jisko aapne bataya uska kaam ho jaayega (uski prarthana poorn hogi), par aapka band ho jaayega — aapk e upar kripa aani band ho jaayegi.
Important note

Kitni bhi zyada supply/urja mentor ya Ashaeiynn se badha di jaaye, aapka kabhi bharega nahi — kyunki aap directly aage baant rahe ho. ("Phata pet" — kitna bhi daalo, bharta nahi.) Aise vyakti hamesha dard mein rehte hain — drishti khoti hai, urja khoti hai, k arobar khone lagta hai; physically, ﬁnancially, mentally dikk at. Shaktiyan kisi ko chhodna nahi chahtin — aapne passwor d de diya to woh 100% aayengi.
Kya karna chahiye (correct behaviour)

Kisi ko jodna hai to directly bolo: "Yeh Ashaeiynn hai, hum isse karte hain, tum bhi jud jao" — khud beech mein mat aao. Ashaeiynn join karne ke liye kisi ko bhi bol sakte ho — yeh bilk ul galat NAHI hai. Bas apni shaktiyon ka access — apni prarthanaayein, sank alp, vidhi — mat batao . That's all. "Jisko bulana hoga woh dharti phaad ke aayega, space se bhi aa jaayega" — bhagwan khud jodne ka intezaam kar lete hain. "Udta teer mat lo" — doosr on ki samasya apne upar lekar unhe apna tatva mat do.
Fix (agar galti ho chuki hai)

Apne mentor ko phone/contact karo taaki ghar ka password badla ja sake. Saare passwords badalne padenge, sabko nikaalna padega — usk e baad aapki urja aap tak rahegi. Otherwise "you are totally in a mess" — batata rahega.
4. GALTI #2 — HAR MANDIR MEIN LET JAANA (Har jagah samarpan bhaav se pranam)
Kaun log

Jinko bhagwan se bahut pyaar hai — raaste mein k oi bhi mandir mila (Shiv mandir, Shani mandir...) wahin dandavat/let gaye, samarpan bhaav se pranam kar diya. Unki galti nahi hai — humein yahi sikhaya gaya hai. P ar: "Tum Ram ke ho, tum sabke ho jao" — yeh baat sirf tumhe pata hai, saamne wale k o nahi; woh apne hisaab se chalta hai.
Kya galat hota hai (mechanism)

1. Har mandir mein bhagwan nahi hote. (Bhaiya very speciﬁc: HAR mandir ki baat nahi ho rahi — K UCH mandir aise hote hain.) 2. Jaise hi aap samarpan bhaav se pranam karte ho, wahan ke doot (chahe doot ho ya pret — kaam wahi karte hain) "ashirwad roop mein" aapke peechhe ho jaate hain. 3. Ghar par Gurudev ka pahra hai, Hanuman Ji Maharaj ke doot khade hain — par entry k e time peechhe wale doot bolenge: "Isne humein pranam kiya tha, hum ashirwad swaroop aaye hain, yeh humein lekar aaya hai." → Entry mil jaati hai → password ka access mil gaya. 4. Ek baar gaye ho to koi badi baat nahi: ghar aakar 2-3 din deepak lagaoge, prarthana karoge, sab Kalyan Lok chala jaayega — aap theek ho jaoge. 5. Problem DAILY jaane se hai (usi mandir mein): Jis pandit/shakti ne woh mandir sthapit kiya hai, woh daily apni shaktiyon ka aavahan karta hai (isiliye mandir chalta hai). Aavahan hote hi Kalyan Lok bheji gayi shaktiyan wahan se chhootkar wapas aa jaati hain — aur aap agle din phir mandir gaye, phir password de diya. Ek cycle ban jaata hai. 6. Phir woh shakti sochti hai: "Yeh deepak/bhog Hanuman Ji Maharaj ko kyun ja raha hai, mujhe milna chahiye." Bhog to woh le nahi sakti (guru vachan ki wajah se deepak Hanuman Ji tak hi jaayega), par jo RETURN (return gift/urja) wapas aata hai, usko woh password use karke attain kar leti hai. 7. Result: "Humne Baba ko deepak arpit kiye, Baba ne sweekar hi nahi kiye" — nahi, wahan se sab aaya, return bhi aaya, par tu jisko lekar aaya usi ne sab le liya. Aapko yahan (Guru) se milne wali urja kahin aur jaati hai, aur aapka patan shuru ho jaata hai.
Kya karna chahiye (correct behaviour / rules)

Mandir jaana MANA NAHI hai. "Hum kabhi nahi kehte mandir mat jao — jao, itne sundar mandir hain, alag-alag vidyayein hain, sant-mahatma hain, seekho." Par apna Ram tattva mat bhoolo. Kabhi-kabhi jaana (15 din mein ek baar, hafte mein ek baar, 2-3 din mein ek baar, darshan ke liye) — k oi dikkat nahi. Ghar aao, deepak lagao, shaktiyan aayengi-chali jaayengi. That's all.

Daily usi ek mandir mein jaana + samarpan bhaav se pranam = nuksaan. Sankalp lekar mandir jaate ho to koi dikkat nahi. Mandir mein sakshi maankar deepak jalana (us mandir ki shakti ko pranam kiye BINA) — bahut achhi baat hai, koi dikkat nahi. Raaste mein bike par mandir dekh kar thoda jhukna / aadar dena — woh A ADAR hai, samarpan nahi; usse kuch nahi hota. Aadar zaroor dena — "main kisi k o nahi maanta" wali akad mein mat rehna, warna toot jaoge. Sirf safai/seva karne jaate (mandir chamkate) to bhi koi dikkat nahi thi — gadbad "samarpan-bhaav wale pranam" se hoti hai.
Ghar walon ke baare mein (FAQ se)

Ghar wale (mummy-papa) daily mandir jaate hain → shaktiyan 100% ghar aayengi, PAR jo mandir ja raha hai woh hi lekar aayega aur wohi phansega — agar uske paas aapka password nahi hai. Agar aapne mummy-papa ko apni vidhi NAHI batayi hai aur sirf aap hi karte ho → chinta mat karo, access aapke paas hi rahega. Aapka deepak, aapka jaap, aapki shakti aapke paas rahegi. Agar vidhi bata di hai → unhe bolo mandir daily jaana band kar dein, ya mentor se password change karvao.
5. GALTI #3 — HAR BHAGWAN KI POOJA / HAR MANTRA / SIDDHIYON KA SHAUK
Kaun log

Jinko har bhagwan ki pooja, har vidhi, har mantra, har vidya seekhne ka shauk hai: "Lakshmi mantra bhi aana chahiye, Bhairav kavach chahiye, Hanuman ji ka astra, Mata ki kripa, Ganesh bhagwan ki kripa, Dhumavati sadhna, yakshini/pishachini powerful hai..." Alag-alag sadhnayein karke gyaan ka bhandaar banna chahte hain → phans jaate hain aur dhadaam se girte hain.
Core concept: Siddhi ki Maintenance Cost

Siddhi banana koi bhi sikha dega (YouTube par sab milega: "8 din mein Hanuman siddhi", "Karna Pishachini", "Yakshini"...) — par siddhi ko MAINTAIN kaise karna hai, yeh koi nahi sikhata. Yahi sabse badi galti hai. Har siddhi ki ek lifeline hoti hai aur ek maintaining cost hoti hai. Gaadi analogy (Fortuner): Fortuner 61 lakh mein aati hai, phir pehli servicing, doosri servicing, cleaning-denting-painting, 12-13 ki average — sab maintain k arna padta hai. Har

mahine nayi gaadi loge par servicing nahi karaoge to har gaadi fail ho jaayegi. Itni saari gaadiyan le loge to unka bojh aur karza — insaan usi bojh k e tale mar jaata hai. Yahi siddhi hai. Jitni badi sadhna, utni hi badi maintenance. 10 mahine ki sadhna ki maintenance cost bhi 10 mahine ke hisaab se rahegi. (Fortuner mein ₹10 ka petrol daalwaoge to dhakka bhi nahi lagega.) 6 mahine ki tapasya se bani siddhi ke baad dheele ho gaye → maintenance cost kaun dega? Siddhi maintain nahi rakhi to wahi pret bankar aapki jaan kha jaayegi. Aise log urja banate rehte hain aur urja waste hoti rehti hai.
Core concept: Ek Tattva Prabal Karo (Iron & Water analogy)

Hypothetical example: maan lo Shiv tattva = iron (loha), Ram tattva = jal (paani). Koi sochta hai "mere paas loha bhi hai, paani bhi — dono se k aam karunga." Sunne mein achha lagta hai. Par koi drishti wala shaana vyakti aayega: loha thoda sa hai → chumbak (magnet) rakhega, loha khinch lega. Paani thoda sa hai → aag jalayega, paani udd jaayega. Dono siddhiyan gayin — peechhe bacha "baba ji ka thullu." PAR agar ek hi tattva par kaam kiya hota: 100 ton loha pada hai → hazaaron magnet rakh do, loha nahi khiskega, ulta magnet khud khinchkar lohe ke paas aa jaayega aur aisi chipkegi ki jaane ka naam nahi legi — saamne wale k o apna magnet wahin chhodkar aana padega. Laakhon cubic cm jal hai → poore planet ki aag bujha do. Hydraulic pump ka example: jo loha nahi utha sakta, woh paani ka pressure utha leta hai; bade-bade ship/truck hydraulic se chalte hain. Moral: Laakhon alag-alag tattva banane se achha hai EK hi tattva ko prabal kar lo. Ek mantra rakho, ek devta rakho, ek tattva rakho — duniya mein aisa k oi kaam nahi jo sambhav na ho. Alag-alag mantron se alag-alag sookshm sharir bante hain → alag-alag vulnerable conditions ban jaati hain ki aapko har tattva se kheencha ja sake.
Core concept: Kripa vs Siddhi

Kripa aur siddhi mein bahut fark hai. Kripa ke peechhe bhaago, siddhiyon ke peechhe nahi. Mat bolo "mere paas Hanuman Ji ki siddhi hai" — bolo "mer e upar Hanuman Ji Maharaj ki KRIPA hai." Jo kripa-patra ban jaata hai use siddhiyon ki avashyakta nahi padti — usk e liye duniya ki saari shaktiyan kam ho jaati hain. (Patra = grahan shakti ka paatra.) Siddhi to bahut nimn (chhoti) cheez hai; kripa bahut badi hoti hai.
Ashaeiynn mein siddhi-system kaise kaam karta hai

Aapke paas jo shaktiyan/siddhiyan kaam karti hain woh permanent nahi hotin — unki SHIFT chalti hai. Aaj koi siddhi, kal koi aur. Zaroorat ke hisaab se "screen" di jaati hai: negativity dekhni hai to negativity ki screen, devta darshan ki screen, sharir ke ang dekhne ki screen, bhavishya/past dekhne ki, santon se baat karne ki — k aam hote hi wapas le li jaati hai. Gurudev ki kripa se shaktiyon ki continuous servicing hoti hai, continuous jagran chalta hai — tabhi shaktiyan channelize hoti hain. Siddhi ki maintenance k a yahi kharcha Ashaeiynn uthata hai. Isliye particular ek siddhi kabhi aapke peechhe khadi nahi milegi.
Kya karna chahiye

Zyada mantron mein mat ghuso — faayde mein rahoge. Jitni badi sadhna kar rahe ho, usi ko continue rakho — jaise dharti k a paani add-on na ho to sookh jaata hai, waise hi naam-jaap continuously chalta rehna chahiye. "Try karo Ram ka naam chalta rahe." Do din jhatka lagne par kisi ke behkave mein aakar mantra mat badlo ("aaj yeh mantra kar lo, kal woh") — k ahin ke nahi rahoge. Aapka kaam aap hi ko karna padega — chahe astral ho ya physical. Har vyakti aapk o push de sakta hai, access dila sakta hai, par kaarya aapko khud karna hai.
6. GALTI #4 — MANN-ICHCHHA CHALANA (Vidhi poori na karna)
Kaun log

Jo apne mann ki bahut chalate hain: bola gaya 10 din karo, 5 din karke soch liya "baaki baad mein; bhagwan ko sunna hoga to 5 din mein bhi sun lega." Jo time-period diya gaya, jo guru vachan diye gaye, unko nahi nibhaate.
Kya hota hai

Shaktiyan kaam karna band kar deti hain. Dosh alag lagta hai. ("Shaktiyan aakar thappad maar ke jaati hain" — bahut bura haal hota hai.) Especially dangerous: agar Mata ke tatvon/bhakton ke saath khilwaad kar liya (kisi mandir/sadhak ne kuch upay bataya aur aapne poora nahi kiya) — Mata ki shaktiyan chhodti nahi hain, bahut zyada nuksaan kar deti hain. Aap lene kuch gaye the, ho kuch aur gaya. Ashaeiynn/Ram tattva wale to shaant hain (kisi par astra nahi uthate, haath jode rakhte hain), par har jagah aisa nahi hai.
85% / 15% ka observation

More than 85% logon ke kaam kehte hi ban rahe hain. Jo 15% ke nahi ho rahe, woh inhi galtiyon ki wajah se. Kuch log jhooth bhi bolte hain ki "humne sab kiya" — Gurudev bata dete hain ki jhooth bol rahe hain. Ashaeiynn unhe phir bhi aur upay batata hai, bina daante ("Aap humein nahi bataoge to humein koi fark nahi padega — fark aapk o padega, shaktiyan aapke saath rahengi"). Jo phir bhi theek nahi hote, unke liye Gurudev ka uttar: "Beta, unka samay nahi aaya. Jab unka theek hone ka samay aayega to apne aap kaarya ho jaayega. Samay nahi aaya to intezaar karo."
Kya karna chahiye

Jo process bataya gaya hai, woh poora karo, jitna bola gaya utna karo. Ashaeiynn ka process simple hai: kuch bhi khao-piyo, kabhi bhi sadhna/jaap/deepak karo — bas continuously karo. Ashaeiynn ko mat do, apne ghar par lagao — bas Guru k a access/ashirwad hona chahiye. Chamatkar hoga.
7. BONUS CASE — BAAR-BAAR GURU BADALNA

Ek aur category: 6 mahine mein kaam nahi hua to naya guru — baar -baar guru change karna. Normal cases mein zyada kuch nahi hota, PAR agar aap kisi ugra/powerful (very aggressive) shakti ke sadhak/guru ke paas the — jaise Mata ka tattva (sabse ugra), Hanuman Ji Maharaj ka tattva (thoda ugra) — aur wahan se nik al kar kisi aur ke paas aa gaye, to wahan ki shaktiyan aapko chhodengi nahi; jeena haraam kar dengi. ("Tumhara guru ghantal ho jaayega.") Ram tattva bahut aaram se/shaant kaam karta hai — isliye Ashaeiynn mein k oi bhi aaye ya jaaye, koi kuch nahi kehta. Tattva aggression scale (transcript ke hisaab se): Ram tattva = sabse shaant → Hanuman Ji Maharaj = thoda ugra → Mata = aur zyada ugra.
8. TATTVA CONCEPTS (FAQ se aaye clariﬁcations)

Ek mahamantra, alag-alag tatva kaise? Base tattva wahi rehta hai, baaki tatva usme mix hote hain. Jaise paani (Ram/jal tattva) ke andar loha, minerals, agni, vayu mix ho sakte hain — paani garam ho jaata hai (agni tattva alternate form mein), par tattva paani hi rahega. Base kabhi nahi badalta. Vishnu ji ke alag roop (jaise Narasimha vs Ram): Fark to rahega — Narasimha bhagwan ka tattva alag aayega, Ram ka alag. Hanuman Ji Maharaj Bholenath ke Rudra avatar hain —

tatva alag-alag hote hain. Ravan ke paas itni shakti isliye aayi thi (devta bhi darte the) — k yunki usne apna tattva prabal kiya tha. Jo yeh 4 galtiyan nahi karta uski urja itni ho jaati hai ki brahmand ki kisi bhi shakti ko lalkaar sakta hai.
9. QUICK RULES SUMMARY (Chatbot ke liye ready-reference)

KABHI MAT KARO: 1. Apni vidhi/mantra/sankalp/prarthana/ghar ke niyam kisi ko mat batao (password leak). 2. Har mandir mein samarpan-bhaav se pranam/dandavat mat karo; ek hi mandir mein daily mat jao. 3. Har devta ki siddhi/har mantra collect mat karo; siddhi banao to maintenance mat bhoolo. 4. Batayi gayi vidhi adhoori mat chhodo; mann-ichchha mat chalao. 5. Baar-baar guru mat badlo (especially ugra shakti ke sadhak).

BILKUL KAR SAKTE HO (yeh galat NAHI hai): 1. Kisi ko Ashaeiynn join karne ke liye bolna/refer karna — bas apni personal vidhi shar e mat karo. 2. Mandir kabhi-kabhi darshan ke liye jaana (weekly/15 din mein) — ghar aak ar deepak laga lo. 3. Sankalp lekar mandir jaana. 4. Mandir mein sakshi maankar deepak jalana (us shakti ko samarpan-pranam kiye bina). 5. Raaste mein mandir dekh kar aadar mein jhukna — aadar zar oor do. 6. Ghar walon ka daily mandir jaana (jab tak unhe aapki vidhi nahi pata).
GALTI HO GAYI TO: - Apne mentor ko contact karo → ghar ka password change karvao. Yahi ekmatra ﬁx hai.

BHAAV/TONE: - Kripa ke peechhe bhaago, siddhi ke peechhe nahi. - Ek naam, ek devta, ek tattva — usk o prabal karo, continuous rakho. - "Jai Siya Ram" ka jap karte raho. Apna Ram tattva kabhi mat bhoolo.
